bosses.name: King Slime
bosses.desc: "Given time, these gelatinous creatures absorb each other and slowly grow in both size and strength."

bosses.name: Desert Scourge
bosses.desc: "...There is always a bigger fish in the sea."

bosses.name: Giant Clam
bosses.desc: The Giant Clam is a mini boss that rarely spawns in the Sunken Sea after defeating the Desert Scourge and is generally the first mini boss that the player will encounter. It receives a huge buff during Hardmode.

bosses.name: Crabulon
bosses.desc: "Fungus and a sea crab. One sought a host; the other, a new home."

bosses.name: Eye of Cthulhu
bosses.desc: The Eye of Cthulhu is a pre-Hardmode boss. It is typically one of the first bosses a player may encounter, as it spawns automatically when a relatively early level of game advancement is achieved.

bosses.name: The Hive Mind
bosses.desc: "Some semblance of a God's mind may survive death, like the twitches of a crushed insect."

bosses.name: The Perforators
bosses.desc: "...The divine turned inside out; their gore now glistens with its perverse treachery, for all to bear witness."

bosses.name: The Slime God
bosses.desc: "...Once revered... as a paragon of the balance of nature. Now... sullied by freshly absorbed muck and grime."

bosses.name: Eater of Worlds
bosses.desc: The Eater of Worlds is a pre-Hardmode Corruption-themed worm boss. It is not a single target, but a string of segments with individual health. When any inner body segment is destroyed, it splits into multiple smaller worms, each with their own head and tail.

bosses.name: Brain of Cthulhu
bosses.desc: The Brain of Cthulhu is a pre-Hardmode, Crimson-themed boss. Fighting the boss and its attendant Creepers is the only way to obtain Tissue Samples, and is one of the ways to obtain usable quantities of Crimtane Ore.

bosses.name: Queen Bee
bosses.desc: "...Fate was cruel to many of their kind."

bosses.name: Skeletron
bosses.desc: "A sorry old man, cursed by an even older cult, caught trespassing on their ancient library."

bosses.name: Dark Mage
bosses.desc: The Dark Mage is a mini-boss that spawns during the Old One's Army event, during wave 5 in Tier 1, and waves 4 and 6 in Tier 3.

bosses.name: Deerclops
bosses.desc: Deerclops is a pre-Hardmode boss encountered in the Snow biome. Fighting Deerclops is not required for game progression, but defeating it rewards the player with coins and other useful items.

bosses.name: Wall of Flesh
bosses.desc: The Wall of Flesh is the final pre-Hardmode boss. Once it is defeated, the world permanently converts to Hardmode, which brings new content and challenges.

drops.item: Hermit's Box of One Hundred Medicines

bosses.name: Cragmaw Mire
bosses.desc: The Cragmaw Mire is a Hardmode mini boss that spawns during Tiers 2 and 3 of the Acid Rain event. It will always spawn underwater on the Sulphurous Sea's ocean floor.

bosses.name: Queen Slime
bosses.desc: Queen Slime is an early-Hardmode, Hallow-themed boss. Fighting Queen Slime is not required for game progression – much like her pre-Hardmode counterpart, King Slime – but her defeat may reward the player with useful items.

bosses.name: The Twins
bosses.desc: The Twins are a Hardmode mechanical boss which are essentially a more difficult version of the Eye of Cthulhu. The Twins are two separate flying entities, Retinazer and Spazmatism, connected by a tendril, each with its own attack pattern and health.

bosses.name: Cryogen
bosses.desc: "The spellwork present in this living seal is inspired, and a tragic homage to every lesson Permafrost taught his student."

bosses.name: Aquatic Scourge
bosses.desc: "Another once grand sea serpent, well-adapted to its harsh environs."

drops.item: Supreme Bait Tackle Box Fishing Station

bosses.name: Brimstone Elemental
bosses.desc: "A peculiar being....she had laid dormant for ages, posing as [Azafure]'s silent matron."

bosses.name: The Destroyer
bosses.desc: The Destroyer is a Hardmode mechanical boss that is essentially a more difficult version of the Eater of Worlds. Its segments share a single health pool, meaning individual segments cannot die.

bosses.name: Skeletron Prime
bosses.desc: "...he crafted a visage so grim, it evoked oblivion itself."

bosses.name: Ogre
bosses.desc: The Ogre is a Hardmode, post-one mechanical boss mini-boss that spawns in the Old One's Army event during wave 7 in Tier 2, and waves 5 and 6 in Tier 3.

bosses.name: Flying Dutchman
bosses.desc: The Flying Dutchman is a Hardmode mini-boss that spawns during the Pirate Invasion event.

bosses.name: Great Sand Shark
bosses.desc: The Great Sand Shark is a Hardmode mini boss that spawns after killing 10 Sand Sharks during a Sandstorm event after Plantera has been defeated. Alternatively, it can be summoned manually by using a Sandstorm's Core in a Desert at any time.

bosses.name: Calamitas Clone
bosses.desc: "But, to think it was housing a clone of the Witch… Detestable."

bosses.name: Leviathan and Anahita
bosses.desc: "Although she claims dominion over all the world's oceans, in truth she is a recluse of the deep."

bosses.name: Astrum Aureus
bosses.desc: "With this experiment concluded, he will certainly be examining you next. Watch yourself."

bosses.name: Plantera
bosses.desc: Plantera is a Hardmode boss that can be fought in the Underground Jungle after all three mechanical bosses (The Twins, The Destroyer, and Skeletron Prime) have been defeated. Plantera drops a Temple Key upon being defeated, allowing access to the Jungle Temple.

bosses.name: Empress of Light
bosses.desc: "Though her title is lofty, she is more an emissary for the powers beyond and forces of nature."

bosses.name: Mourning Wood
bosses.desc: The Mourning Wood is a Hardmode, post-Plantera mini-boss that spawns during the Pumpkin Moon event. It is the Pumpkin Moon equivalent of the Everscream, which behaves in an almost identical way to the Mourning Wood.

bosses.name: Pumpking
bosses.desc: The Pumpking is a Hardmode, post-Plantera mini-boss that spawns during the Pumpkin Moon event. He is the event's final enemy and can move freely through blocks.

bosses.name: Everscream
bosses.desc: The Everscream is a Hardmode, post-Plantera mini-boss that spawns during the Frost Moon event. It is the Frost Moon equivalent of the Mourning Wood, which behaves in an almost identical way to the Everscream.

bosses.name: Santa-NK1
bosses.desc: Santa-NK1 is a Hardmode, post-Plantera mini-boss that spawns during the Frost Moon event. When below half health, the face and beard of the Santa mask are torn apart to reveal a rather morbid mechanical skull underneath.

bosses.name: Ice Queen
bosses.desc: The Ice Queen is a Hardmode, post-Plantera mini-boss that spawns during the Frost Moon event. She is the event's final enemy and can move freely through blocks.

bosses.name: The Plaguebringer Goliath
bosses.desc: "An innocent queen, forced to bear an agonizing existence. This is nothing short of a crime against nature."

bosses.name: Ravager
bosses.desc: "A sickening flesh golem built for the sole purpose of savage, relentless destruction."

bosses.name: Golem
bosses.desc: Golem is a Hardmode, post-Plantera boss fought in the Jungle Temple. It attacks the player by stomping on them, launching its fists, and firing barrages of projectiles.

bosses.name: Martian Saucer
bosses.desc: The Martian Saucer is a Hardmode, post-Golem mini-boss that spawns during the Martian Madness event after it is at least 30% completed. The Martian Saucer hovers in the air and can pass through blocks.

bosses.name: Astrum Deus
bosses.desc: "...Revered as the God of the night sky. It is said to devour dying stars and birth new ones in turn."

bosses.name: Duke Fishron
bosses.desc: "Outlandish as they may seem, this species is the single mightiest of the seas."

bosses.name: Mauler
bosses.desc: The Mauler is a post-Moon Lord mini boss that spawns during Tier 3 of the Acid Rain event. It swims towards the player and alternates between three attacks at random, each telegraphed by a different roar.

bosses.name: Nuclear Terror
bosses.desc: The Nuclear Terror is a post-Moon Lord mini boss that spawns during Tier 3 of the Acid Rain event. It has 3 special attacks and 2 other attacks which it uses when not using the special attacks. The 3 special attacks are as follows:

bosses.name: Lunatic Cultist
bosses.desc: "Do not expect to learn much from those tattered tomes. They were penned with misguided zeal."

bosses.name: Solar Pillar
bosses.desc: The Celestial Pillars (also known as the Lunar Pillars, Lunar Towers, or Celestial Towers) are four late-Hardmode, stationary bosses that appear during the Lunar Events after the Lunatic Cultist has been defeated.

bosses.name: Vortex Pillar
bosses.desc: The Celestial Pillars (also known as the Lunar Pillars, Lunar Towers, or Celestial Towers) are four late-Hardmode, stationary bosses that appear during the Lunar Events after the Lunatic Cultist has been defeated.

bosses.name: Nebula Pillar
bosses.desc: The Celestial Pillars (also known as the Lunar Pillars, Lunar Towers, or Celestial Towers) are four late-Hardmode, stationary bosses that appear during the Lunar Events after the Lunatic Cultist has been defeated.

bosses.name: Stardust Pillar
bosses.desc: The Celestial Pillars (also known as the Lunar Pillars, Lunar Towers, or Celestial Towers) are four late-Hardmode, stationary bosses that appear during the Lunar Events after the Lunatic Cultist has been defeated.

bosses.name: Betsy
bosses.desc: Betsy is a Hardmode, post-Golem mini-boss that spawns once during the seventh and final wave of Tier 3 of the Old One's Army event. Like all enemies in the Old One's Army, she will despawn upon completion or failure of the event.

bosses.name: Moon Lord
bosses.desc: The Moon Lord is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist boss. He is the final boss of the versions of Terraria.

drops.chance: 100% / 100% (Expert) / 100% (if the player has not used the Demon Heart)

bosses.name: Profaned Guardians
bosses.desc: "...Rather simple constructs, extensions of the Profaned Goddess' power."

bosses.name: The Dragonfolly
bosses.desc: "...The first offshoots [of the Dragons]...pure enough to retain the great strength of their forebears."

bosses.name: Providence, the Profaned Goddess
bosses.desc: "There was silence, until Providence spoke once more. 'Let us go forth, and light the world anew.' And it was so."

bosses.name: Storm Weaver
bosses.desc: "This beast, while of lesser stature than the Devourer, is a great danger in its own right."

bosses.name: Ceaseless Void
bosses.desc: "A contained, previously inert portal sealed in the Dungeon."

bosses.name: Signus, Envoy of the Devourer
bosses.desc: "An aberration that defies all explanation, borne of the Distortion and revered by the Onyx Kinsmen."

bosses.name: Polterghast
bosses.desc: "Long-dead prisoners seek their zealous revenge..."

bosses.name: The Old Duke
bosses.desc: "One must wonder what goes through the mind of a fading legend."

bosses.name: The Devourer of Gods
bosses.desc: The Devourer of Gods is a post-Moon Lord boss that is intended to be fought after the Storm Weaver, Ceaseless Void, Signus and Polterghast have been defeated. The fight against this boss is lengthy and difficult, with several phases and numerous varying attacks and behaviors.

bosses.name: Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth
bosses.desc: "The return of the Age of Dragons, dashed. Just like that, it is but ashes in the wind…"

bosses.name: Exo Mechs
bosses.desc: The Exo Mechs are a group of post-Moon Lord bosses that can be fought simultaneously after defeating Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth, and intended to be fought around the same time as Supreme Witch, Calamitas.

bosses.name: Supreme Calamitas
bosses.desc: Supreme Witch, Calamitas is a major boss intended to be fought after defeating Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth, and around the same time as the Exo Mechs.

bosses.name: Adult Eidolon Wyrm
bosses.desc: "The chaotic teleportation energy enrages an abyssal behemoth..."
